run_distributed_evals: run distributed evaluation jobs on a SLURM cluster using YAML config files and submitit
launch_evals_with_parsed_args: launch evaluation jobs with parsed config dicts using submitit AutoExecutor on a SLURM partition
create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance that wraps eval args and calls eval_main when invoked
review_Trainer_checkpoint: review the Trainer checkpoint method that returns a DelayedSubmission for preemption recovery
run_batch_launch_evals: run multiple evaluation configs from a batch YAML file as a SLURM job array
